15693423.quick: Best from an empty field at the end of the Battle Phase.

14558127.quick: Discards itself to negate an effect that adds from Deck, summons from Deck, or sends from Deck.

97268402.quick: During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate the effects of that face-up monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn.

94145021.quick: After a Deck-to-hand add, prevents further Deck-to-hand additions that turn.

8267140.quick: Pays 1000 LP to banish a Spell/Trap instead of sending it to a useful GY.

18144507.quick: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

41420027.quick: Pays half your LP to deny a summon or Spell/Trap activation.

57566760.quick: Your main Xyz attacker. Needs two Level 3 Mikanko. Finds Sword, survives battle and makes the opponent take battle damage you would have taken. No Equip Card is needed for her reflection.
57566760.caution: Two Level 3 Mikanko are required. After a completed attack, including a direct attack, detach 1 at the end of the Damage Step to attack again in a row. Two materials can supply up to three attacks; the Equip search alone is once per turn.

81260679.quick: Reveals herself to search a Mikanko card, then discards. Preparation finds her. Ceremony can bring her onto the field, where she can equip a suitable GY Equip Spell as a Quick Effect.
81260679.caution: The discard happens during resolution, not as activation cost. She is Level 6, not a Rank 3 material. Ceremony does not properly Ritual Summon her.

11161666.quick: The bridge to two Level 3 bodies: becoming equipped lets her summon a non-Illusion Mikanko from Deck.
11161666.caution: She has no battle-damage reflection. After Twins sends her, decline her optional GY-equip effect if you need Fire Dance to revive her. Her Deck-summon effect imposes the Mikanko Extra Deck restriction.

6327734.quick: Your protection piece. With any Equip Card under your control, your opponent cannot target your Mikanko cards. Becoming equipped searches a Mikanko Trap.
6327734.caution: Her damage reflection and battle survival need an Equip Card on her specifically. Targeting protection is not immunity to all effects.

18377261.quick: An equipped Ha-Re searches a Mikanko Equip Spell. A good Arabesque / Fire Dance extender.
18377261.caution: A monster that is merely summoned without becoming equipped does not trigger her search. Double-Edged Sword is not a Mikanko Equip Spell, so Ha-Re cannot search it.

102380.quick: Tribute two eligible opposing monsters to Special Summon it to their field. Its 3000 ATK becomes a damage target.
102380.caution: You cannot Normal Summon or Set in that turn, before or after its summon. Tributing is the Special Summon procedure, not a formal Tribute Summon. Opposing summon negation may still matter.

63941210.quick: Tribute one eligible opposing monster; leave 3300 ATK on their field. You may also summon another Kaiju to your own field if they control one.
63941210.caution: Each player can control only one Kaiju. To give them a second, first remove the first. It is not a once-per-turn tribute procedure.

84550369.quick: Sets up the GY and a Mikanko Spell/Trap. The doctrine’s first line sends Sanaki and sets Fire Dance.
84550369.caution: Only one of its two effects can be used per turn. You cannot use the GY Ritual-summon effect later in the same turn as its normal effect. The normal effect restricts later Extra Deck summons.

80044027.quick: Summons a Mikanko from hand or GY and equips it. Can optionally put a negated monster from their GY back on their field as a damage target.
80044027.caution: Only one activation per turn. The optional opposing revival requires a legal GY target. Equipping it through Ohime is not the same as activating its summon effect.

41927278.quick: Adds 2000 ATK and assigns battle damage to BOTH players. Against active Uzuhime, your damage share goes to the opponent too: you take 0.
41927278.caution: It is not a Mikanko card. Equip it to the target, not automatically to your attacker. Against a 0 ATK active reflector, a 3300 Kaiju becomes a 10600-damage attack.

43527730.quick: Summons a differently named Mikanko, transfers itself onto it and returns the former equipped monster to hand. Useful for recycling a Kaiju.
43527730.caution: The summon/bounce effect is once per turn. If you bounce the only opposing monster, you may have no monster left to tribute to place the Kaiju again.

16259549.quick: An unlocked Rank 3 that can survive battle by detaching. Its battle opens the Zeus route.
16259549.caution: It does not reflect battle damage. Have enough LP to survive and a material to prevent destruction; two different players being unable to target it does not make it invulnerable.

72167543.quick: Overlay a surviving Rank 3 or lower Xyz in Main Phase 2 to build the Zeus stack.
72167543.caution: The alternate route is Main Phase 2 only. Do not summon under the Mikanko restriction.

90448279.quick: A field reset after an Xyz has battled. Overlay Downerd and retain its stacked materials.
90448279.caution: Its effect sends your other cards too. You cannot use the ordinary Mikanko combo and simply add Zeus after battle under its Extra Deck restriction.

93039339.quick: A one-body emergency Xyz when the opponent’s recent Extra Deck activity meets its condition.
93039339.caution: The alternate summon ends your further Normal/Special Summons for the turn. Use your highest-ATK monster, not any arbitrarily chosen smaller monster.

60303245.quick: Converts a Normal Summoned 0 ATK Mikanko into a Link body.
60303245.caution: A Special Summoned Hu-Li does not meet its material text. You cannot Normal Summon her on a Lava Golem turn.

29301450.quick: Generic interaction, but unavailable after Linkage resolves because it is not a Sky Striker Ace.

2857636.role: Link-2 Spell/Trap removal after Hound’s lock is clear.

9839945.quick: Uses your own LIGHT Ohime plus another body to access an eligible opposing LIGHT GY monster.
9839945.caution: A strong opposing GY target is conditional. Her availability does not justify abandoning an easier reflection kill.

48770333.quick: Third Kaiju; another 3300 ATK damage target.
48770333.caution: Check the current card text and turn restrictions before committing.

96729612.quick: Finds Level 6 Ohime from Deck. The Ritual Spell recovery is optional and usually unused in this profile.
96729612.caution: Preparation is not Pre-Preparation of Rites; they search differently.

44649322.quick: Special Summons a Mikanko from hand ignoring its conditions. The GY effect supplies another Mikanko card to the GY.
44649322.caution: It does not properly Ritual Summon Ohime. Its summoned monster returns to hand during the opponent’s End Phase.

57736667.quick: Protects its equipped monster from effect destruction, offers a post-battle bounce and GY revival of an eligible Mikanko.
57736667.caution: Reviving an improperly summoned Ritual is still prohibited. A revived monster is banished when it leaves the field.

79912449.quick: Equip an opposing monster, then control it while you control a Mikanko. It remains equipped under your control.
79912449.caution: Both players are prevented from activating that monster’s effects while you control it. Losing Rondo sends the equipped monster to GY.

24299458.quick: Sends cards as cost. Chained Quick-Plays can become efficient payment.

35269904.quick: Turns an opposing monster-effect activation into access to a Normal Spell/Trap.
35269904.caution: Adding needs an opposing monster on field; a card it sets cannot be activated that turn.

14532163.quick: Clears opposing backrow or Attack Position monsters while you control no face-up cards.
14532163.caution: Use it before establishing face-up Mikanko or Equip Spells.

53174748.quick: Equip a targeted face-up opposing monster to your Mikanko as an Equip Spell.
53174748.caution: It is targeting interaction; check the opponent’s protection. Do not count its equipped monster as a monster-zone Link or Xyz material.

54862960.quick: An equipped Ni-Ni can take a face-up opposing monster during their turn until the End Phase.
54862960.caution: She must be equipped and it must be the opponent’s turn. Targeting protection can prevent the steal.

42705243.quick: A set Promise summons a Mikanko from hand/Deck and may equip it from your hand/GY.
42705243.caution: A trap normally cannot activate on the turn it was set. The summoned monster is banished when it leaves the field.

78199891.quick: While you control a Mikanko, target a face-up monster and equip an Equip Spell from Deck that can legally equip to it.
78199891.caution: You need a Mikanko already on field. Rondo can equip to an opponent’s monster and immediately take it.

8264361.quick: No Main Deck monster here is DARK. An opponent’s DARK stolen with Rondo, Talent or sided Ni-Ni can supply it, but you must actually control that monster and avoid the Mikanko restriction. A DARK only in their GY cannot satisfy the summon. A DARK Xyz/Link fallback can also become material later, but that is a detour. A conditional toolbox slot; lower purchase priority.
8264361.caution: Two monsters including DARK. All generic routes require an unlocked turn.

65741786.quick: Hu-Li + Ha-Re can make her on an unlocked turn. Her opponent-turn Link effect then needs I:P plus another available monster, e.g. a leftover Ohime for S:P. Making I:P with your only two bodies does not supply that extra body. Legal but too resource-hungry for this basic plan.
65741786.caution: Two non-Link monsters; Link Rating 2. All generic routes require an unlocked turn.

38342335.quick: Phoenix (counting as 2) + a leftover Hu-Li (1) works on an unlocked turn. The shuffle also needs a discard. Three ordinary Level 3 Mikanko can meet the rating, but Sanaki’s usual extension has already locked you. A conditional toolbox slot when spare bodies and a discard are available.
38342335.caution: At least two differently named monsters totaling Link Rating 3. All generic routes require an unlocked turn.

86066372.quick: Unicorn (3) + an extra Effect Monster (1) is legal when unlocked, and makes 5300 ATK through Unicorn. The previous list did not provide a reliable spare-body sequence for this ladder. Keep as an optional ladder payoff, never assume it is a routine finish.
86066372.caution: At least two Effect Monsters totaling Link Rating 4. All generic routes require an unlocked turn.

98127546.quick: Example: your I:P (2) + Hu-Li (1) + Ha-Re (1) + an opposing Effect Monster (1). That is four actual bodies, totaling five. Three small Mikanko plus one ordinary opposing Effect Monster total only four, so are insufficient. Legal in special resource states, inefficient here.
98127546.caution: At least four Effect Monsters totaling Link Rating 5; may use one opposing monster. All generic routes require an unlocked turn.

26077387.quick: Quick Effect Tributes herself to deploy a Sky Striker Ace to the Extra Monster Zone.

37351133.quick: Can Special Summon herself from hand when another Ace is Summoned. From the GY, an opposing EMZ monster leaving by battle or your effect can relaunch Roze and optionally negate a face-up monster; each effect is once per turn.

63166095.quick: With an empty Main Monster Zone, adds any Sky Striker card except another Engage; if 3 Spells are already in the GY when it resolves, it may also draw 1.

9726840.quick: Sends another controlled card during resolution, deploys an Ace, then locks Extra Deck summons to Aces.

98338152.quick: Negates a face-up monster; at 3 Spells it can take control and occupy your Main Monster Zone.
